title: Upper mass bound for an integer multiplicity current: M_W(τ(M, θ, ξ)) ≤ ∫_{M∩W} θ dHⁿ
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, T ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n and R = (C, θ, ξ) an IMRep in U with R.Represents T (T(ω) = ∫_C θ ξ(ω) dHⁿ for all test forms ω in U). Then for every set W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_W(T) = T.massOn W ≤ R.measure W = (θ Hⁿ⌞C)(W).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), T.massOn W ≤ R.measure W
